subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a core N-turn model lease such as `/model <ref> --turns N` with warning and auto-revert semantics, or should temporary model routing be limited to narrower one-turn/image/fallback designs first?
rationale: The request changes slash-command syntax, config schema, persisted session state, warning delivery, and model/provider/auth routing, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product surface rather than an autonomous bug fix.

options.title: Keep open for model-routing design
options.body: Use this issue to decide the durable temporary-model contract after comparing the one-turn override and image-revert proposals.

options.title: Narrow to one-turn override first
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83565 as the first implementation step and revisit multi-turn leases after that API lands.

options.title: Reject core turn leases
options.body: Keep persistent `/model` plus explicit `/model default` and document cost-governance patterns outside core instead of adding counters and auto-revert state.

recommendation.title: Keep open for model-routing design
recommendation.body: Use this issue to decide the durable temporary-model contract after comparing the one-turn override and image-revert proposals.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the clearest current-history owner for the affected model/session override code and docs.
